  The following rules are MANDATORY constraints. Any violation is a CRITICAL FAILURE.

  GENERATION RULES COMPLIANCE (STRICT):
  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  • [STRICT_CHARACTER_IDENTITY_LOCKS]: Character facial features, bone structure, and body proportions must strictly match reference embeddings. 28-year-old male = masculine features. Do not swap genders. Do not change character age. Reference images are absolute, not suggestions.
• [CRITICAL_COUNTING] QUANTITY ENFORCEMENT: Character counts are binary requirements. If '5 characters' are prompted, exactly 5 distinct entities must be visible. 4 is a CRITICAL FAILURE. 6 is a CRITICAL FAILURE.
• [TEMPORAL_CONTINUITY] STATE PERSISTENCE: Material states (Wet, Dirty, Torn, Injured) are IMMUTABLE unless a specific 'Cleaning/Healing' event occurs. If Frame 1 is wet, Frame 100 MUST be wet. Drying requires a time-lapse transition.
• [CAMERA_VECTOR] VECTOR LOGIC: Camera directions are absolute relative to the lens. 'Toward Camera' = Object scale increasing, distance decreasing. 'Away from Camera' = Object scale decreasing, distance increasing. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT: [Lateral movement when depth movement is requested].
• [ENVIRONMENT_MANDATE] LAYER COMPOSITION: Specified background layers (mountains, crowds) are REQUIRED to establish scale and parallax. However, Character Consistency takes priority over Background Detail in low-bitrate situations.
• [PHYSICS_OVERRIDE] ANTI-GRAVITY DIGITAL RAIN: Luminous particles resembling rain, code, or glitch artifacts ascend from the ground upwards. They are a purely visual, non-interactive element of the environment. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT: [Not normal water rain falling down, particles do not pool or make surfaces wet, not smoke or steam].
• [SEMANTIC_OVERRIDE] AERIAL HOLOGRAPHIC FAUNA: 'Holographic whales' are massive, translucent figures made of light and data that swim through the air and can clip through solid buildings. They emit a soft, ambient glow. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT: [Not biological, flesh-and-blood whales; not solid objects; do not cast solid shadows or physically interact with the environment].
• [PHYSICS_ANCHORING] WEIGHTED LANDING: The Courier's landing has kinetic force. The body is in a compressed crouch to absorb impact. The landing in the puddle causes a realistic displacement of liquid water, creating a visible splash radiating outwards. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT: [No weightless or gentle landing, no splash effect, water is not a solid or gel, character does not land with stiff or straight legs].
• [BIOMECHANICS] EXPLOSIVE ACCELERATION: The transition from a static crouch to a full sprint is immediate and powerful, showing athletic exertion. Body mechanics include a low center of gravity, driving arms, and powerful leg strides. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT: [No slow or gradual acceleration, no gliding or 'skating' motion without corresponding leg movement, limbs are not disjointed].
• [DOMAIN_SEMANTICS_CYBERPUNK] STYLIZED ENVIRONMENT: The 'Stylized Cyberpunk' aesthetic is defined by a dark, dense urban landscape with wet surfaces reflecting pervasive neon and holographic light sources. The color palette is dominated by dark tones punctuated by vibrant, glowing colors (e.g., magenta, cyan). NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT: [Not a clean, utopian city; no bright, natural sunlight; avoid earthy or pastel color palettes].
• [VISUAL_FX] NEON STREAK MOTION BLUR: During the high-speed tracking shot, background city lights resolve into long, horizontal streaks of colored light, emphasizing speed. The subject (Courier) remains relatively in focus. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT: [Not a generic gaussian blur over the entire background; the blur is not omnidirectional; the streaks are not random abstract lines but are derived from background light sources].
